captures.note: the full pack (1.85 GB; salvo hn news-boards2, read 21 Oct 2026; file mtime); 596 configs. The raw rows cite the packs of 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-18: the token counts of all 496 rows are equal in this pack (hn report: 313 compared pairs equal; this converter: all 496).
repo head (README, runner/adapters); the repo carries an 11-config flagship sample only, the pack the full set

salvo: salvo14/mig C2 wave (converter by the C2 agent)

extractions.tool: extract.py: one row per configs/<id>/ of the pack (config.json fields verbatim; run_start / run_end = earliest started_at / latest ended_at over all attempts of send-log.json; send_outcomes = count of terminal_state over the send-log positions; fidelity_match_count / fidelity_fields = for the configs of the harnesses claude-code and api--official, the tally of the six scalar fields condition/date/hourly/max/min/name == 'match' over the meta.json of every slot whose send-log terminal_state is not infra-failed); empty tokens/times = absent in the file. The tree extracted from the tarball is byte-identical (checked on one member).

tables.where: all 596 configs/<id>/ of the pack: config.json + send-log.json + slot meta.json (see extractions)

model_id.note: the config's model_id: the benchmark's own model id (a Cursor / Claude Code / Kiro / API model name)

fidelity_match.note: NOT a number the benchmark publishes: our tally (k of N) of the six scalar fidelity fields of the slots' meta.json (extractor fidelity-extractor-v1), as the legacy rows did
